title: pyrus dolichofoliolata
intro: Pyrus dolichofoliolata, commonly known as Korean pear, is a species of deciduous tree in the family Rosaceae. This plant is known for its edible fruit, which is rich in nutrients and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The health benefits of Pyrus dolichofoliolata include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its ability to soothe digestive issues and reduce stress, and its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
